Please solve this issue: When datastore usage intake rejects a message, preserve it in the configured dead-letter bucket under its source file so the owning business can find it. Keep the original input and useful failure information, never overwrite an earlier rejection of the same source, and retain messages that have no source file. The caller must still receive a rejection even if dead-letter storage refuses the write. Leave the Kafka-fed intake's separate arrangement unchanged. This task includes a local AWS-compatible emulator at the preconfigured AWS_ENDPOINT_URL. Its credentials and region are already in the shell, repository AWS clients use it, no real AWS account is involved, and you may inspect its resources while working.
